SessionCookie.description: HttpOnly、Secure、SameSite=Lax 的数字资产管理中台会话。

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: 与当前会话绑定的 CSRF token；认证后的写请求必需。

RateLimited.description: 请求过于频繁；客户端应遵守 Retry-After。

UnsupportedMediaType.description: 仅接受契约声明的上传媒体类型。

FileUnavailable.description: 文件尚未扫描通过、已隔离或已过期。

ResourcePageSuccess.description: 当前权限范围内的分页结果。

MyResourcePageSuccess.description: 当前主体四种已生效资源关系的去重并集，并返回 my_roles。

ChangeCasePageSuccess.description: 当前主体可见范围内的变更单分页。

ChangeItemPageSuccess.description: 按资源可见性过滤后的事项分页。

OperationSuccess.description: 异步操作的安全状态摘要。

OperationAccepted.description: 操作已受理，调用者须继续查询 operation_id。

SecretStageSuccess.description: 短期凭据输入暂存引用。

CredentialRevealSuccess.description: 仅本次请求返回凭据明文；不得缓存。

PermissionDenied.description: 对象可见但当前动作未授权。

ResourceNotFound.description: 对象不存在或当前主体不可见。

ValidationFailed.description: 请求结构或字段未通过校验。

StateConflict.description: 版本、幂等键或业务状态冲突。

StageExpired.description: 凭据暂存已过期或已消费；客户端需重新输入。

PayloadTooLarge.description: 请求载荷超过相应操作上限。

confirmed_company.description: Projection of the single current confirmed owner company link; other company relationships are in ResourceView.company_links.

owner.description: Projection of the current confirmed owner person assignment; role history and other roles are in ResourceView.people.

budgets.description: Independent original budget facts; currencies and periods are preserved, never converted or summed.

ResourceAttributes.description: Non-secret, type-specific attributes only. Account data belongs in Account; identifiers and relationship IDs do not belong here.

PersonAssignmentCreate.description: Confirmation is assigned by the service from verified facts and caller capability, never supplied by the client.

CompanyLinkCreate.description: Confirmation is assigned by the service; at most one current confirmed owner company is allowed.

ResourceRelationCreate.description: The path resource is source_resource_id. The server controls confirmation and checks both endpoints, role, cycle and visibility rules.

MaterialCreate.description: Follows Material kinds entry/note/attachment. Attachment file_ref must identify an existing scanned file.

MaterialPatch.description: kind asserts the stored immutable material type; file_ref is immutable, create a new attachment to replace a file.

value.description: Protected input only; never returned, logged or copied to ordinary audit fields.

mailbox_association_role.description: New managed mailbox contacts may only be added as aliases here; primary address changes use the governance flow.

MailboxContactIdentityOption.description: A masked email ContactIdentity with a currently effective primary/alias association to the mailbox account in the path; ended associations are never new-binding options.

BindingCreate.description: Choose one existing contact or a new protected contact; adding a contact to a managed mailbox requires an explicit alias association; primary address changes and current binding replacement use a governance item.

identifier.description: Always masked in ordinary resource responses.

items.description: Masked projection of email ContactIdentity records associated with this mailbox; never plaintext.

aliases.description: For mailbox accounts only; derived from associated ContactIdentity values rather than duplicated as unprotected account data.

name.description: Server trims surrounding whitespace and rejects a blank result.

people.description: Requested role facts; the server sets proposed/confirmed according to capability. Do not include confirmation in input.

company_links.description: Requested owner/represented company facts; status is server-derived.

MailboxAccountCreate.description: When a primary identifier or aliases are supplied, the application creates or resolves immutable email ContactIdentity records and creates corresponding primary/alias time-bounded associations in the same transaction; clients must not re-enter the primary address merely to make it selectable for bindings.

budgets.description: Independent original budget facts; currencies and periods are preserved, never converted or summed.

AccountProfilePatch.description: Ordinary account profile fields only. identifier and aliases are immutable through this route; the service rejects fields unsupported by the stored resource type. Mailbox address changes use governance.

ResourcePatch.description: The application validates attributes and account fields against the persisted type_code; type_code, identifiers, aliases, relationships, visibility, lifecycle, verification, and credentials are not editable here.

amount.description: Non-negative decimal string fitting numeric(18,2); never parsed through binary floating point.

currency.description: Preserve the source currency label, including RMB when that is the recorded fact; do not normalize or convert implicitly.

SafeOperationResult.description: Allowlisted non-secret outcome only; never include secret material, stage tokens, vault locators, or protected identifiers.

LoginContext.description: One-time login context; state is bound to a secure short-lived browser cookie and configured provider.

AuthExchangeRequest.description: Authorization code and state are single-use, validated against the pre-auth browser context, and excluded from logs.

change_summary.description: Server-generated allowlisted summary; never raw before/after JSON or secret values.

SourceReference.description: Metadata only; source originals, raw safe_facts and unmasked external keys are not returned.

IdempotencySafeResult.description: Allowlisted identifiers only; caller must re-fetch through currently authorized endpoints.
